title: New Hire Orientation & Tooling Playbook
author: Maya Patel
content:
Overview:

This playbook is the canonical guide for orienting new hires at Redwood Inference. It combines the people-ops onboarding checklist, role-specific 30/60/90 templates, access provisioning procedures, an internal tools primer, and first-week agenda recommendations. Use this doc to coordinate hiring managers, IT, security, and the new hire so that day 1 is productive and secure.

Who this is for:
- Hiring managers preparing a new joiner
- People Ops coordinators running orientation
- IT/Security staff provisioning accounts and devices
- New hires who want a single source of truth for the first 90 days

Goals:
- Ensure all essential accounts and hardware are provisioned by day 1 (target SLA below).
- Provide a clear 30/60/90 learning and success plan for common roles.
- Standardize tooling orientation so engineers, product, and SREs can ship quickly and securely.

Quick links (internal):
- People Ops onboarding JIRA: /jira/POPS-ONBOARD
- Device procurement form: /tools/device-request
- Okta SSO admin: https://okta.redwood.local
- Console sandbox: https://console-sandbox.redwood.local

Onboarding SLAs (target):
| Item | SLA (business days) | Owner |
|---|---:|---|
| Okta / core SSO account enabled | 1 | People Ops / IT |
| GitHub org membership + repo access | 2 | Eng manager / DevOps |
| PagerDuty & Datadog alert access | 2 | Eng SRE |
| Laptop procurement (if new) | 3-7 | IT procurement |
| Security training assigned | 1 | Security |
| Full access to Redwood Console (prod sandbox role) | 3 | Platform team |

Note: these are targets. Use expedited channel when access will block day-1 work.

Day 0-1 Checklist (numbered steps for managers + Ops):
1. Confirm start date and arrival window with People Ops.
2. Add new hire to People Ops onboarding JIRA and attach signed offer.
3. Create Okta account and add to SSO groups (engineering/product/sales as appropriate).
4. Request laptop via Device procurement form (include preferred OS, accessories).
5. Add to relevant Slack channels, Mail Groups, and Confluence spaces.
6. Grant GitHub org membership and base repo access (create PR template if repo requires).
7. Assign mandatory trainings: security, privacy, code of conduct (links provided in the People Ops JIRA).
8. Schedule 60-minute orientation with People Ops and 30-minute manager check-in for day 1.
9. Assign onboarding buddy and create calendar invites for first-week paired sessions.
10. Run through initial access verification script (see Access Verification below).

Access Verification (run with new hire on day 1):
- Okta SSO login successful
- Email access and distribution lists verified
- Slack signed in on desktop and mobile
- GitHub access to at least 2 repos: onboarding and team repo
- Console sandbox access: able to view the ‘Teams’ dashboard and run a sample request in staging
- PagerDuty: able to view on-call rota and acknowledge a test alert
- Datadog: able to view sample dashboards and logs

First-week recommended agenda (sample):
- Day 1 morning: People Ops orientation (benefits walkthrough, payroll, policies), office tour or virtual welcome, equipment handoff.
- Day 1 afternoon: Team intro, assign buddy, first 1:1 with manager (30m), access verification walkthrough.
- Day 2: Codebase orientation (eng), product roadmap overview (product), sales shadow (go-to-market).
- Day 3: Security and compliance deep-dive (required), CI/CD demo, sample PR and deploy walkthrough.
- Day 4: Start first small onboarding task and pair with buddy.
- Day 5: Manager 1:1 + set 30/60/90 objectives.

30/60/90 Templates (role-agnostic, editable):
- 30 days: Observe, learn internal workflows, complete mandatory trainings, deliver first small task or doc.
- 60 days: Own a non-critical feature or process, demonstrate familiarity with primary tools, participate in on-call shadowing if role requires.
- 90 days: Independently ship a medium-sized piece of work, present a retrospective on onboarding, and agree on promotion/career goals with manager.

Role-specific starters (high level):
- Engineering: clone main repos, run local dev with `make dev`, create a test feature branch, complete the runtime onboarding lab in the Console sandbox.
- SRE / Platform: validate runbooks, join on-call shadow, perform a canary deploy in staging with telemetry checks.
- Product / PM: review 3 recent PRDs, join customer calls, author a small requirement doc and sync with design.
- Sales / CS: complete security and data-handling training, shadow enterprise onboarding call, review contract templates and SLA docs.

Hardware & equipment policy summary:
- Standard issue laptop: M1/M2 MacBook Pro (engineering preferred) or equivalent Windows device.
- Perks budget for monitors, ergonomic chair reimbursement up to $400.
- Replacement lifecycle: 36 months standard; expedited replacement available for critical failures.
- Device enrollment: All company devices must be enrolled in MDM and disk encryption enabled.

Expense & procurement process (short):
1. Fill device/expense request at /tools/device-request.
2. Manager approval via JIRA workflow.
3. IT issues fulfillment ticket, tracks via procurement board.
4. Submit receipts to Expensify under project code REDWOOD-OPS.

Security and compliance checkpoints (must be completed by end of week 1):
- Complete security awareness training.
- Confirm MFA is enabled on all accounts.
- Sign data handling acknowledgement and NDAs where applicable.
- For private deployments or customer-sensitive roles, complete additional onboarding checklist provided by Security (link in People Ops JIRA).

Internal tools primer (what to use when):
- Slack: informal and synchronous team communication. Use #team-<name>, #all-hands, and private channels for sensitive topics.
- Confluence: single source of truth for processes, runbooks, and design docs. Use templates for PRDs and ADRs.
- GitHub: code, PR reviews, and issue tracking. Branch naming convention: team/short-desc.
- CI/CD: Buildkite for most engineering pipelines; run the `buildkite setup` task in the onboarding lab.
- PagerDuty: on-call notifications and escalation. Make sure your local mobile app notifications are enabled.
- Datadog: service dashboards, logs, synthetic checks. Dashboards live under `teams/<team-name>`.
- Okta: SSO and MFA management. Use Okta to access internal apps.
- Vault/KMS: secrets access is role-based and requires requesting a Vault token scoped to projects.
- Redwood Console (internal): production and staging routing, model deployments, and telemetry. New hires get read access to sandbox by default; production access is provisioned by manager request.

Manager responsibilities (short list):
- Own the 30/60/90 goals and provide weekly check-ins for the first 90 days.
- Assign an onboarding buddy and ensure pairing sessions.
- Verify critical access and remove blockers within SLA.
- Outline clear success metrics for the first 90 days and review them at week 2 and week 8.

Buddy program (how it works):
- Buddy length: 6 weeks. Goals: answer day-to-day questions, demo workflows, and provide social context.
- Recommended time commitment: 2 hours/week of paired time for the first 3 weeks, then 1 hour/week.

Common onboarding blockers & escalation path:
- Missing GitHub access: escalate to DevOps lead and tag #onboarding-help in Slack.
- Laptop delivery delay > 7 days: People Ops to escalate to procurement; provide temporary cloud workstation.
- Console access failure: open ticket with Platform team and request temporary staging credentials.

Measuring onboarding success (KPIs):
- Day-1 access completion rate (target: 95%)
- Time-to-first-merge (median) (target: <= 21 days for engineers)
- New-hire satisfaction score from 30-day survey (target: >= 4.0/5)

Appendix A — Access request templates (copy into JIRA):
- GitHub access request: "Team: <team-name> — New hire <name> — Repos: <list> — Role: write/read"
- Console production access request: "New hire <name> — Customer scope: <customer> — Justification: <reason> — Manager approval required"

Appendix B — Sample first ticket for a new engineering hire (copy to repo):
Title: onboarding: hello-world endpoint
Description: Create a small hello-world endpoint that returns service health. Steps: 1) create branch team/onboarding-hello 2) add endpoint and tests 3) open PR with 'onboarding' label 4) assign buddy for review
